video_title: Is Trading Their Draft Pick A Bad Idea For Warriors?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors considering trading their 11th pick for an immediate contributor
quotes.excerpt: if they're going to opt out of a lottery pick here, it's got to be for a player

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Before we go, I want to circle back around to some of the stuff that Anthony Slater wrote about with the Warriors. One thing that he questioned was what would happen with the number 11 pick in the draft that the Warriors own. Remember, Stephen Curry is resigned, multi-year contract to remain with the Warriors. Steph Curry has indicated this will not be his last year; in fact, he would like to do a contract extension. Jimmy Butler is going to miss the bulk of the year, hopefully he's back after the All-Star break, but he's a player in his mid-30s coming off an ACL. So, if they're going to opt out of a lottery pick here, it's got to be for a player who can help them immediately and not for just this season, not a rental. A guy who will be a core player for the next couple of years. The player that Slater floats is Trey Murphy from the Pelicans.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Warriors have had interest in him for a while.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans listening to trade offers for Trey Murphy
quotes.excerpt: the Pelicans, after really never wanting to listen on Trey Murphy, are listening to Trey Murphy
quotes.quote: A number of teams have. I think it was Marc Stein who reported first, and if it wasn't him, I apologize, I'm not trying to disregard anything, who said that the Pelicans, after really never wanting to listen on Trey Murphy, are listening to Trey Murphy, but their standard is very high, as it should be.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors have valuable assets to trade for immediate help
quotes.excerpt: it's going to be at least probably two first round picks and the number 11 pick
quotes.quote: It's going to be at least probably two first round picks and the number 11 pick is a pretty good one to start with.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy's contract status impacts trade feasibility
quotes.excerpt: you have to send something out for him as well, in addition to potentially that
quotes.quote: You have to send something out for him as well, in addition to potentially that. Trey Murphy makes what, 28 million dollars or something like that? You have to send something out for him as well.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy would be an ideal fit for the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: he'd be a great fit for the Warriors. He's a 6'8, pretty athletic, volume three-point shooter
quotes.quote: He'd be a great fit for the Warriors. He's a 6'8, pretty athletic, volume three-point shooter who's just entering his prime. He'll be 26 next season, so you're getting a help-now guy as you're trying to be competitive during Steph's twilight, however long that may be. Obviously, Steph still playing at an incredibly high level, but then also a bridge to the post-Steph future potentially.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors trying to replicate the Klay Thompson archetype
quotes.excerpt: you're trying to replicate a Klay Thompson pairing there
quotes.quote: With Trey Murphy, what you're trying to replicate there, and maybe I should just have Jackson cut this out, you're trying to replicate a Klay Thompson pairing there is what you're trying to do. I don't think he's the defender Klay Thompson is.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy is a good player, not a Hall of Famer
quotes.excerpt: Trey Murphy is a really nice player, don't try to turn him into a Hall of Fame player
quotes.quote: He's not. Let's just relax. They're not trying to do that. They're trying to get a good player. Just stop. Trey Murphy is a really nice player, don't try to turn him into a Hall of Fame player.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy's profile as a high-volume shooter
quotes.excerpt: Trey Murphy is a really good player who has yet to be an All-Star
quotes.quote: Trey Murphy is a really good player who has yet to be an All-Star in his first five years, but he is a big wing who's a high-volume three-point shooter.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors are not currently a championship contender
quotes.excerpt: they're not a championship contender. Like you can't keep being a play-in team
quotes.quote: Also, Steph's no longer in his prime, as great as he still is. The Warriors have come to the realization that, quite frankly, they're not a championship contender. Like you can't keep being a play-in team and then not get out of the play-in, look yourself in the mirror and say, 'Ah, we're a piece away.' No, they want to be a competitive team in Steph's twilight. There's honor in being competitive. That's where they are.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading multiple first-round picks for Trey Murphy is questionable
quotes.excerpt: I'm not really sure trading multiple first-round picks for Trey Murphy is a smart move
quotes.quote: I'm not really sure trading multiple first-round picks for Trey Murphy is a smart move for a team in Golden State's situation either. Number 11 pick's a pretty good pick. You're getting a young guy that in theory you can have be a player you're building around going forward. It's the same reason why, for as great as Giannis is, I thought them giving up their draft for him was a debatable move given the situation that their whole roster is at. I'm not saying they got to try to just tank with Steph, but I'd probably be trying to be a little less aggressive than that ultimately.
